title: ticket template: compliance request, false positive (template_version 2)
description: FALSE_POSITIVE (owner, 2026-11-04): "this is not a thing, the scanner is wrong". Evidence is required and a reviewer confirms (the finalized review). NO expiry; instead it is RE-CHECKED when the rule, the tool version or the code changes (a later submission of the finding naming another tool version or code ref re-opens the question on the request ticket). Opens a FALSE_POSITIVE_REQUEST; the disposition itself is merged to the protected branch. KDEC-037.

receipt.description: A custody receipt for the evidence (a store's object id or signature).

rule_id.description: The rule the false positive is about.

tool_version.description: The tool version that produced it.

code_ref.description: The commit or content hash of the code it was judged on.
